contactForm.notes: Contact details will be plain text only.

commentsOrRatings.notes: No comments, scores, or user ratings are planned.

analytics.notes: No first-party or third-party analytics are enabled in the current project.

localStorage.notes: The site will not create first-party local-storage records.

cookies.notes: The site itself will not set cookies; embedded providers may operate under their own policies.

gameIframes.implementation: Shared game player on the homepage and published additional-game routes
gameIframes.notes: Frames are created only after a player action. The provisional main source is rejected safely until replaced; additional games use verified itch.io wrappers.

youtubeIframes.implementation: Lazy youtube-nocookie.com embeds after each game article
youtubeIframes.notes: No autoplay; third-party requests begin when the deferred iframe loads.

payments.notes: No checkout, donation, or payment collection is planned.

uploads.notes: No file upload feature is planned.

advertising.notes: No advertising scripts or ad placeholders are planned.
